I will draft a notice to members about the work day based on the committee's notes and save it as notice.md.

The work day is Saturday 14 November from 09:30 to 12:30. Members should bring gloves. The club supplies soup. Nell booked the tool sharpener for 10:00. Ibrahim will send the notice by 7 November. Wren will shut off the water for the winter on the day itself.

Tessa drafted a winter closing checklist. Committee members should send her comments by 10 November.

I will exclude internal items like the roof invoice dispute, fee reminders, and the second tap city request from the notice. The document should be written as a formal committee letter to members. No template was provided.

Members should know the garden closes at the end of November. They will need to prepare beds and water before the water is shut off. Compost has arrived in the bays. The notes do not list specific tasks beyond tool sharpening and the water shut-off.

The notice should use plain, friendly language. It must not invent tasks absent from the minutes. The current date is November 11, 2026, which is after the November 7 deadline for sending the notice.

The notice will be dated 11 November 2026 to reflect the current date rather than backdate it to the 7 November deadline.

The notice will be a short letter rather than a list of facts. It will state the water shut-off as an affirmative fact after the work day, avoiding contrastive negation.The notice to members about the work day has been written. It is saved as notice.md. It was based on the committee's notes.
